uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: While at 85% max HP or above, this Pokémon's movement speed is increased by 15%. While at high HP, movement speed is increased.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, creating a fiery whirlwind around the user and damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. This boosted attack remains readied until used. Basic and boosted attacks lunge at the target opposing Pokémon. Becomes a boosted attack every third attack, creating a fiery whirlwind that deals damage to enemies in the area of effect. This boosted attack remains readied even after leaving combat for a prolonged period of time.

Becomes a boosted attack every third attack, creating a fiery whirlwind that deals damage to enemies in the area of effect. This boosted attack remains readied even after leaving combat for a prolonged period of time.
The user dashes at the designated opposing Pokémon then pecks three times, damaging opposing Pokémon hit. Fly toward an enemy and attack 3 times.

The user dashes forward cloaked in flame, damaging opposing Pokémon in their path and increasing the user's movement speed by 30% for 2.5s if it hits. Fly in the designated direction while cloaked in flame, attacking enemies in the path. This also increases the movement speed for a short time.

Increases the user's Defense penetration for 3s and reduces the movement speed of opposing Pokémon in the user's path by 30% for 5s if this move hits. For a short time after this move hits, Talonflame's abilities and basic attacks partially ignore the enemies defense.

The user readies a boosted attack and dashes through the designated opposing Pokémon with a swift attack, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect around the user and restoring the user's HP when it hits. Fly at the designated enemy, dealing damage. Also makes the next basic attack a boosted attack.
Increases the damage of this move. Increased damage.

The user dashes toward the designated location then attacks the area around them three times, damaging nearby opposing Pokémon. The user can choose to dash in the direction of movement afterward. Fly toward the designated area and attack multiple times. Escape in a direction of your choice after using this move.

The user readies a boosted attack and flies up into the sky for up to 3s, becoming untargetable and increasing their movement speed by 65%. When this move is used again, or after 3s, the user dives at the designated location, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. If this move hits a Pokémon from the opposing team, the current cooldown of this move is reduced by 40%. Fly up into the sky. Using this move again will cause you to dive to the designated area and attack, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect. Your next basic attack becomes a boosted attack. This move's cooldown is reduced by 40% if it hits an enemy.
Throws opposing Pokémon hit for 0.4s. Also throws enemies when this move hits.

The user becomes unstoppable and dives at the designated location, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect when they land and receiving 5% remaining HP recoil damage if it hits. Opposing Pokémon hit by this move are marked for 4s. If the user hits a marked target with a boosted attack, the cooldown of Flame Charge or Aerial Ace is reset and the mark on the first target hit is removed. Dive to the designated location while cloaked in flame, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect. Also deals recoil damage to the user when it hits. Performing a boosted attack within a set amount of time after this move hits will reset the cooldown of Flame Charge or Aerial Ace.
Reduces damage received by 25% per opposing Pokémon hit for 5s (up to 3 times; maximum 75%). Deals less recoil damage when this move hits.

The user performs an aerial somersault and sweeps forward, becoming unstoppable, receiving 50% reduced damage, damaging opposing Pokémon in their path and shoving them toward the end of the sweep, then damaging opposing Pokémon again. This Unite Move cannot go through walls. Perform an aerial somersault before charging forawrd, dealing damage to enemies in this move's path and shoving them.
Buffs: 80% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
